exposure: labor contractions becoming regular and ≤ 5-minutes apart before admission
cohort: 1,656 primiparous women aged 18-35 years with singleton pregnancies who began labor spontaneously at home
finding: Primiparous women who labor at home until their contractions become regular and ≤ 5-minutes apart are more likely to be in active labor on hospital admission and less likely to experience oxytocin augmentation, epidural analgesia, and cesarean birth.
mod_finding: Primiparous women who delayed hospital admission until their contractions were regular and ≤ 5-minutes apart were less likely to have a cesarean birth.
